name: Fruitville Grove Pumpkin Fest
hours_label: 10 AM – 5 PM · Free admission & parking; rides $1–$10
blurb: Hayrides, pony rides, a petting zoo, haunted manor and costume contests at a Sarasota family farm. Admission and parking are free; rides are $1–$10.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Florida's best-known weekly farmers market fills downtown Sarasota with local produce, flowers, baked goods and prepared food. Free to browse; a perfect first stop for visitors and relocating buyers wanting a feel for downtown life.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
blurb: A beloved Sunday sunset tradition on world-famous Siesta Beach, with drummers, dancers and a crowd gathering on the sand. Free and family friendly.

name: Oktoberfest Downtown Sarasota (ROCKtoberfest)
blurb: Downtown Sarasota's bayfront Oktoberfest brings live music, food and drinks, and is dog-friendly. Free admission, with no tickets needed for food or beverage.
